title: friesodielsia alpina
intro: Friesodielsia alpina, commonly known as the Mauwake tree, is a plant species native to Papua New Guinea. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Friesodielsia alpina include its anti-inflammatory and antimalarial properties, which make it a valuable resource for indigenous communities. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, such as dielsin, and other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
